enabled.description: Enable or disable the autologout feature

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Number of minutes after which the inactive user is logged out automatically. Default is 60 minutes (1 hour)

promptBeforeIdleSeconds.description: Number of seconds before the idle timeout where the user will be asked if it's still active. A dialog will be shown. Default is 10 seconds. Set to 0 seconds to disable the prompt.

useWorkerTimers.description: Enable/disable the usage of worker thread timers instead of main thread timers. Default is true. If you experience some browser incompatibility, you may try to set this to false.

logoutIfDisconnected.description: Enable/disable the automatic logout also on users that are logged in but with no Backstage tabs open. Default is true.
